subject: Demo / Initial discovery call — Redwood Inference & Orion Systems
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@orion-systems.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + request to schedule discovery call (Redwood Inference)

Hi Emily — great to meet you over email. I’m Marissa (AE on this account) — Redwood Inference helps teams run production LLM inference with predictable latency/cost.

We’d love to set up a 30–45 min initial discovery to understand your goals (prod timelines, data/sensitivity, and who needs to be involved). Would you and Raj be available for any of these windows next week (PT)?

- Tue 6/23, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed 6/24, 1:00–1:45pm
- Thu 6/25, 11:00–11:45am

Please include anyone from engineering, procurement, and security who should be on the call. I’ve attached a brief Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align on next steps.

Agenda ideas: quick intros, high-level product demo tailored to Orion, current infra/constraints, security/compliance Qs, mutual action plan and next steps.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: 20260615-Redwood-MAP.pdf

Of the times you proposed, Tue 6/23 10:00am PT works best for us. Can you confirm and send a calendar invite? Also please include a short agenda and any pre-reads (MAP is great).

Thanks,
Emily Chen

Emily / team — Rachel here (sales ops) — happy to get this on the calendar. Confirming Tue 6/23 10:00–10:45am PT as the preferred slot. I’ll send a calendar invite for 30 minutes with a brief agenda; we can extend to 45 if needed.

Proposed invite details:
- Title: Redwood Inference — Initial discovery (Orion Systems)
- When: Tue, Jun 23, 2026 10:00–10:30 AM PT (we can extend)
- Attendees: Marissa Cole (AE), Avery Johnson (SE), Rachel Kim (Sales Ops), Emily Chen (Product, Orion), Raj Patel (Eng, Orion), Security & Procurement (TBD)

Emily — can you confirm the right security and procurement emails (or should we cc procurement@orion-systems.com and security@orion-systems.com)? Also let us know if you prefer a demo on sample data or a conceptual walkthrough to start.

I’ve attached the MAP Marissa referenced and will include the SOC2 questionnaire for security to review ahead of the call.

Thanks — sending invite after confirmation.

Rachel Kim

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@orion-systems.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-16T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Pre-read + a couple quick tech questions before discovery

Hi Emily — Avery (SE) here — looking forward to the call. I attached a one-pager with suggested demo flows. Quick questions to help me prep:

1) Do you want us to demo on a public sample dataset or would you prefer we run through an example with your telemetry/metadata (sanitized)?
2) What environment are you targeting (cloud provider / VPC / on-prem)?
3) Any specific latency or throughput targets you can share now?

If security will join, it would be helpful to get any specific SOC2 controls or privacy constraints up front so we can have the right folks on the call.

Thanks — attaching demo-flows-one-pager.pdf.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai

Attachment: 20260616-demo-flows-one-pager.pdf

Thanks — Tue 6/23 is generally good but we need to move the start to 10:00–10:45 PT (our team has a standing meeting that day) — that works with the proposed slot. Please include SE and security on the invite; procurement (procurement@orion-systems.com) will join for commercial questions.

Also: we’re particularly interested in discussing a private deployment option and data residency. Would be great if someone from security (cc’d) can confirm the SOC2 questionnaire timeline.

See you then.
